summary: Ruanyun Edai Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 22, 2026, attaching a press release dated June 17, 2026, that unveils its Smart Campus Services business. The release reports cumulative unaudited operating revenue of approximately US$9.49 million from September 2025 through May 2026, with accelerating momentum. The filing is a routine business update disclosing operational metrics and strategic initiatives, including a planned transformation into Formind Group. No extraordinary corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or management change is present. The content is an ordinary operational disclosure with no special-situation characteristics.
